why.B2.1: The milky white layer on the blood sample and hepatomegaly are characteristic of Glycogen Storage Disease Type I.
The presence of a milky white layer on the blood sample surface and hepatomegaly, as indicated by the liver edge extending to the iliac crest, are characteristic of Glycogen Storage Disease Type I.
